params.description: The unique ID value of the layer to target (or the layer name as a string)

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to check

functions.name: layer_tilemap_get_id
functions.description: This function can be used to retrieve the unique ID value of the tile map element on a layer. Note that this function is specifically designed for use with tile maps that have been added in the IDE, as if you add a tile map to a layer through code using the function layer_tilemap_create(), then it will return the unique ID for the tile map element added. If the given tilemap ID is incorrect or the tilemap doesn't exist, the function will return -1.

params.name: layer_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the layer to target (or the layer name as a string)

functions.name: layer_tilemap_get_colmask
functions.description: This function can be used to retrieve the sprite that is being used as the collision mask for this tilemap.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The Id of the tilemap element for which you wish to know the colmask of.

functions.name: layer_tilemap_set_colmask
functions.description: This function can be used to set the sprite that is being used as the collision mask for this tilemap. The dimensions of the sprite must match the dimensions of the sprite being used for the tileset. If the function succeeds it will return 0, if it fails it will return -1

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The Id of the tilemap element for which you wish to know the colmask of.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the sprite to be used as the collision mask

functions.name: tilemap_clear
functions.description: Using this function you can clear/set all the tiles on a given tile map. A default value of 0 will clear all the tiles from the layer (essentially making all tiles "empty"), while you can use the dedicated tile_* functions to create your own tile data to clear the tile map with.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: tiledata
params.description: The tile data to use to clear the layer

functions.name: tilemap_get
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the tile data from a cell of the tile map element. Note that we are using x/y cell positions based on the size of the tile map grid and not as a position in the room, so "cell_x" is a value from 0 to tile map width, and "cell_y" is a value from 0 to tile map height. If you need to get the data for a tile at a specific room position then you need to use the function tilemap_get_at_pixel().

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the tile-data of

params.name: x_cell
params.description: The cell along the x-axis to get the tile data from

params.name: y_cell
params.description: The cell along the y-axis to get the tile data from

functions.name: tilemap_get_at_pixel
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the tile data from a position (within the room) of the tile map element. If you need to get the tile data from a specific tile cell you should be using the function tilemap_get() instead.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the tile-data of

params.name: x
params.description: The position along the x-axis to get the tile data from (in room pixels)

params.name: y
params.description: The position along the y-axis to get the tile data from (in room pixels)

functions.name: tilemap_get_cell_x_at_pixel
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the x-axis position of an individual tile map cell by giving the relative x-axis position within the room. Note that if the value is outside of the tile map area, and no cell is available, it will return -1.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the cell x position of

params.name: x
params.description: The x position within the room to use for getting the cell

params.name: y
params.description: The y position within the room to use for getting the cell

functions.name: tilemap_get_cell_y_at_pixel
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the y-axis position of an individual tile map cell by giving the relative y-axis position within the room. Note that if the value is outside of the tile map area, and no cell is available, it will return -1.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the cell y position of

params.name: x
params.description: The x position within the room to use for getting the cell

params.name: y
params.description: The y position within the room to use for getting the cell

functions.name: tilemap_get_frame
functions.description: Since tiles can be animated, it can sometimes be useful to know which frame is currently being drawn and react accordingly, so with this function you can retrieve the current frame index for a given tile map.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the frame index of

functions.name: tilemap_get_global_mask
functions.description: This function can be used to retrieve the bit mask value for all tile maps, returning the current mask value or -1 if there is an error or 0 if no mask is specified. For further information on global tile map bit masks, see the function tilemap_set_global_mask().

functions.name: tilemap_get_height
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the height (in cells) of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the height of

functions.name: tilemap_get_mask
functions.description: This function can be used to retrieve the bit mask value for the given tile map. For further information on tile map bit masks, see the function tilemap_set_mask().

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the mask of

functions.name: tilemap_get_tileset
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the index value of the tile set asset assigned to a given tile map element on a layer.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the tile set from

functions.name: tilemap_get_tile_height
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the height (in pixels) of each tile cell of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the tile cell height of

functions.name: tilemap_get_tile_width
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the width (in pixels) of each tile cell of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the tile cell width of

functions.name: tilemap_get_width
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the width (in cells) of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the width of

functions.name: tilemap_get_x
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the x position (within the room) of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the x position of

functions.name: tilemap_get_y
functions.description: Using this function you can retrieve the y position (within the room) of the tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to get the y position of

functions.name: tilemap_set
functions.description: This function can be used to set any cell (grid square) within the tile map element on the layer to a new tile. The function will return true if the tile was successfully set and false if there was an issue and it wasn't set.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: tiledata
params.description: The tile data to set

params.name: xcell
params.description: The cell (grid) position to set along the x-axis

params.name: ycell
params.description: The cell (grid) position to set along the y-axis

functions.name: tilemap_set_at_pixel
functions.description: This function can be used to set a cell within the tile map element on the layer to a new tile using the actual position of the tile to change within the room. The function will return true if the tile was successfully set and false if there was an issue and it wasn't set.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: tiledata
params.description: The tile set data to set

params.name: xcell
params.description: The x position (in the room)

params.name: ycell
params.description: The y position (in the room)

functions.name: tilemap_set_global_mask
functions.description: This function can be used to set the tile bit mask for all tile maps in the game.

params.name: mask
params.description: The mask value to use

functions.name: tilemap_set_height
functions.description: This function can be used to resize a tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to set the height of

params.name: height
params.description: The height value (in "cells")

functions.name: tilemap_set_mask
functions.description: This function can be used to set the tile bit mask for a single tile map.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to set the mask of

params.name: mask
params.description: The mask value

functions.name: tilemap_set_width
functions.description: This function can be used to resize a tile map element.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to set the width of

params.name: width
params.description: The width value (in "cells")

functions.name: tilemap_tileset
functions.description: Using this function you can change the tile set asset assigned to a given tile map element on a layer.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: tileset_index
params.description: The new tile set index to use

functions.name: tilemap_x
functions.description: This function controls the position along the x-axis of the room of the asset tile map element on the layer.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: x
params.description: The x position for the tile map

functions.name: tilemap_y
functions.description: This function controls the position along the y-axis of the room of the asset tile map element on the layer.

params.name: tilemap_element_id
params.description: The unique ID value of the tile map element to change

params.name: y
params.description: The y position for the tile map

functions.name: tile_get_empty
functions.description: This function can be used to check whether a given set of tile-data is for an empty tile or not.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to check

functions.name: tile_get_flip
functions.description: This function can be used to check whether in a given set of tile-data the tile has been flipped or not.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to check

functions.name: tile_get_index
functions.description: This function can be used to get the tile index (the position of the tile within the tile set image) from a set of tile-data.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to check

functions.name: tile_get_mirror
functions.description: This function can be used to check whether in a given set of tile-data the tile has been mirrored or not.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to check

functions.name: tile_get_rotate
functions.description: This function can be used to check whether in a given set of tile-data the tile has been rotated 90 degrees or not.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to check

functions.name: tile_set_empty
functions.description: This function can be used to set a given set of tile-data to be an empty tile. The function will return a modified tile-data set which can then be applied using the tilemap_set() function.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to set

functions.name: tile_set_flip
functions.description: This function can be used to set a given set of tile-data to flip the tile or not. The function will return a modified tile-data set which can then be applied using the tilemap_set() function.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to set

params.name: flip
params.description: Set to true to flip and false to leave it as-is

functions.name: tile_set_index
functions.description: This function can be used to set the tile index (the position of the tile within the tile set image) for a set of tile-data. The function will return a modified tile-data set which can then be applied using the tilemap_set() function.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to set

params.name: index
params.description: The integer index value of the tile set to use

functions.name: tile_set_mirror
functions.description: This function can be used to set a given set of tile-data to mirror the tile or not. The function will return a modified tile-data set which can then be applied using the tilemap_set() function.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to set

params.name: mirror
params.description: Set to true to mirror and false to leave it as-is

functions.name: tile_set_rotate
functions.description: This function can be used to set a given set of tile-data to rotate the tile 90 degrees or not. The function will return a modified tile-data set which can then be applied using the tilemap_set() function.

params.name: tiledata
params.description: the tile-data to set

params.name: rotate
params.description: Set to true to rotate and false to leave it as-is

functions.name: script_execute
functions.description: This function calls a Script Function or Method with the given arguments.

params.name: scr
params.description: The name of the function/script that you want to call
The different arguments that you want to pass through to the function/script

functions.name: script_execute_ext
functions.description: This function calls a Script Function or Method, with the given arguments passed as an Array.

params.name: scr
params.description: The name of the function/script that you want to call

params.name: array_args
params.description: The array containing the arguments for the function/script

params.name: offset
params.description: OPTIONAL! The offset into the argument array

params.name: num_args
params.description: OPTIONAL! The number of arguments to (from the offset onwards)

functions.name: method_call
functions.description: This function calls a method in its bound context, with the arguments taken from an array or a range in an array.

params.name: method
params.description: method/function that you want to call

params.name: array_args
params.description: The array containing the arguments for the function/script

params.name: offset
params.description: OPTIONAL! The offset into the argument array

params.name: num_args
params.description: OPTIONAL! The number of arguments to (from the offset onwards)

functions.name: script_exists
functions.description: This function will return true or false depending on whether the script or script function with the given index exists. Note that this is not a string, but rather the asset name which holds the unique index for each script (as it would appear in the IDE) or the script function name variable, as defined within the script asset (note that this will not work for method variables).

params.name: scr
params.description: The name of the script that you want to check.

functions.name: script_get_name
functions.description: This function will return the name as a string of the specified script. This name is the one that has been specified for the script in the Asset Browser of the main GameMaker window. For more information about scripts, see The Script Editor.

params.name: scr
params.description: The index of the script that you want to get the name of.

functions.name: sequence_create
functions.description: With this function you can create a new sequence object which you can then add tracks to. The function returns a struct which you can then access to set up the new sequence you have created. The sequence object struct can then be used to create instances of the sequence on a room layer using the function layer_sequence_create().

functions.name: sequence_destroy
functions.description: With this function you can destroy a sequence object that has been created dynamically. This function should be used whenever a dynamically created sequence is no longer required to free up the memory associated with it.

params.name: sequence_struct_or_id
params.description: The sequence object struct or ID to destroy

functions.name: sequence_exists
functions.description: With this function you can check to see if a sequence object exists or not.

params.name: sequence_struct_or_id
params.description: The sequence object struct or ID to check for

functions.name: sequence_get
functions.description: With this function you can retrieve the sequence object struct from a sequence asset index.

params.name: sequence_index
params.description: The sequence index as defined in the asset browser.

functions.name: sequence_get_objects
functions.description: With this function you can retrieve an array of all the object indices that have instances being created within the given sequence.

params.name: sequence_struct_or_id
params.description: The sequence object struct or ID to get the objects from.

functions.name: sequence_instance_override_object
functions.description: With this function you can override (replace) all instances of an object used in a sequence with another one. Note that this can only be done on sequence instances (not sequence objects) and must be done before the sequence starts to play, otherwise it won't work.

params.name: sequence_instance_struct
params.description: The sequence instance struct to modify.

params.name: object_id
params.description: The object index of the object within the sequence to override.

params.name: instance_or_object_id
params.description: The object index or instance ID to use to override the sequence objects.

functions.name: sequence_keyframedata_new
functions.description: With this function you can create a new keyframe data struct, supplying the type of track that the keyframe data will be applied to.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of keyframe data to create, a constant, listed above.

functions.name: sequence_keyframe_new
functions.description: With this function you can create a new track keyframe struct, supplying the type of track that the keyframe will be applied to.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of keyframe to create, a constant, listed above.

functions.name: sequence_track_new
functions.description: With this function you can create a new sequence track struct, supplying the type of track that you wish to make.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of track to create, a constant, listed above.

functions.name: shaders_are_supported
functions.description: This function will do a check to see if the chosen target platform supports shaders, returning true if they do, and false if they do not. It is important to note that on Android, if the project does not have any shader resources defined, then the function will always return false, regardless of whether the device supports shaders or not.

functions.name: shader_current
functions.description: This function will return the index ID value of the shader currently being used for rendering, or it will return -1 if no shader is being used.

functions.name: shader_enable_corner_id
functions.description: This function enables the use of corner IDs in shaders.

params.name: enable
params.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) this function.

functions.name: shader_get_name
functions.description: With this function you can retrieve the name of a shader asset.

params.name: shader
params.description: The index of the shader to get the name of.

functions.name: shader_get_sampler_index
functions.description: This function gets the handle of the shader sampler with the given name.

params.name: shader
params.description: The index of the shader to use.

params.name: uniform
params.description: The shader sampler to get the handle of.

functions.name: shader_get_uniform
functions.description: This function gets the handle of the shader constant with the given name.

params.name: shader
params.description: The index of the shader to use.

params.name: uniform
params.description: The shader constant to get the handle of.

functions.name: shader_is_compiled
functions.description: This function will check a shader at runtime to make sure that it has been successfully compiled. This function should be used at the start of the game to make sure that the platform running your game has successfully compiled any shaders used.

params.name: shader
params.description: The shader to check.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_matrix_array
functions.description: This function sets a shader constant to hold an array of matrix values.

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

params.name: array
params.description: A previously initialised array of floating point values.

functions.name: shader_set
functions.description: With this function you can set the drawing target to the given shader and all further drawing will be done using that. You can end shader use with function shader_reset().

params.name: shader
params.description: The index of the shader to use.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_f
functions.description: With this function you can set the value (or values) of a shader constant. You must previously have gotten the "handle" of the constant using the function shader_get_uniform(), and you will have to know what type of constant it is to pass the correct number of floating point values through to it, i.e.: if you have a vec2 you will need to pass two values to the function.

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

params.name: value1
params.description: The floating point value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value2
params.description: The floating point value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value3
params.description: The floating point value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value4
params.description: The floating point value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_f_array
functions.description: With this function you can set a shader constant to hold an array of values. You must previously have gotten the "handle" of the constant using the function shader_get_uniform(), and you will have to have previously initialised the array.

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

params.name: array
params.description: A previously initialised array of floating point values.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_f_buffer
functions.description: With this function you can set values of a shader constant from a buffer. You must previously have gotten the "handle" of the constant using the function shader_get_uniform(), and you will have to have previously initialised the buffer and filled it with buffer_f32 data.

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

params.name: buffer
params.description: The index of the buffer to use.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset position (in bytes) within the buffer to read the data from.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of entires to read from the buffer.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_i
functions.description: With this function you can set the value (or values) of a shader constant. You must previously have gotten the "handle" of the constant using the function shader_get_uniform(), and you will have to know what type of constant it is to pass the correct number of integer values through to it, i.e.: if you have a vec2 you will need to pass two values to the function.

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

params.name: value1
params.description: The integer value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value2
params.description: The integer value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value3
params.description: The integer value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

params.name: value4
params.description: The integer value (or values) to set the shader constant to.

functions.name: shader_set_uniform_matrix
functions.description: With this function you can set the value (or values) of a shader constant to the current transform matrix. You must previously have gotten the "handle" of the constant using the function shader_get_uniform().

params.name: handle
params.description: The handle of the shader constant to set.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_clear
functions.description: This function will clear the specified animation track of all animations, ready to be reassigned.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track to clear.

params.name: reset
params.description: Whether to reset the skeleton to setup pose (defaults to false).

params.name: duration
params.description: How long animating the skeleton back to setup pose will take.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get
functions.description: With this function you can get the current animation set being used by your skeletal animation sprite. The return value is a string, which will be the name of the set as you defined it in your skeletal animation program.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get_duration
functions.description: This function will return the time required for the given animation set to run before looping back to the beginning. The return value is in seconds.

params.name: animname
params.description: The name of the animation set to use.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get_ext
functions.description: This function will return the name of the animation set currently used by the given track number (as set by the function skeleton_animation_set_ext).

params.name: track
params.description: The track number to get the animation set name of.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get_frame
functions.description: This function will return the frame number of the animation on the specified animation track. The function will return -1 if no animation is assigned to the specific track given.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track to get the frame of.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get_position
functions.description: This function will return the current position of the specified animation track in the range (0.0 to 1.0). The function will return -1 if no animation is assigned to the specific track given.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track to get the frame of.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_get_frames
functions.description: This function can be used to retrieve the number of frames that any given skeleton animation has. The function will return 0 if the specified animation does not exist.

params.name: anim_name
params.description: The animation name to get the frames of.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_is_finished
functions.description: This function will return true if the animation on the given track has finished.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_is_looping
functions.description: This function will return true if the animation on the given track is looping.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_list
functions.description: With this function you can populate a (pre-created) DS list with all the names of the animations included as part of the skeletal animation sprite. The names will be strings and can then be used in the other animation functions for these types of sprite.

params.name: sprite
params.description: The sprite index of the Spine skeletal animation to get the list from.

params.name: list
params.description: The ID of the DS list to populate with the animation names.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_mix
functions.description: This function sets the mix value between two animation sets that the instance's skeletal animation sprite will interpolate between.

params.name: animfrom
params.description: The name of the first animation set to interpolate from.

params.name: animto
params.description: The name of the second animation set to interpolate to.

params.name: duration
params.description: The duration of the interpolation (from 0 to 1)

functions.name: skeleton_animation_set
functions.description: This function defines the animation set to be used by the skeletal animation sprite assigned to the instance.

params.name: animname
params.description: The name of the animation set to use.

params.name: loop
params.description: Whether the animation should loop (defaults to true).

functions.name: skeleton_animation_set_ext
functions.description: This function assigns the given animation set of the instance's skeletal animation sprite to the given track number.

params.name: animname
params.description: The name of the animation set to use.

params.name: track
params.description: The track for the animation set to use.

params.name: loop
params.description: Whether the animation should loop (defaults to true).

functions.name: skeleton_animation_set_frame
functions.description: This function will set the animation assigned to the given track to the frame you supply. The frame index should be an real value between 0 and the number of frames for the animation (which you can get using the function skeleton_animation_get_frames). If you supply a value outside of this range, the animation will be looped to make up the difference, for example if the animation has 5 frames and you set the frame to 8, the actual frame shown will be 3.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track to set the frame of.

params.name: index
params.description: The new index for the animation frame.

functions.name: skeleton_animation_set_position
functions.description: This function will set the animation assigned to the given track to the proportional position you supply. The position should be a real value between 0.0 and 1.0. If you supply a value outside of this range, the animation will be looped to make up the difference, for example if the given position is 1.5 the actual position will be 0.5.

params.name: track
params.description: The animation track to set the frame of.

params.name: position
params.description: The new position for the animation track.

functions.name: skeleton_attachment_create
functions.description: This function creates an attachment for the instance's skeletal animation sprite at runtime using a sprite asset from your game.

params.name: sprite
params.description: The sprite_index to get the attachment image from.

params.name: ind
params.description: The image_index to get the attachment image from.

params.name: xorigin
params.description: The x origin for the image being used.

params.name: yorigin
params.description: The y origin for the image being used.

params.name: xscale
params.description: The horizontal scaling of the image, as a multiplier: 1 = normal scaling, 0.5 is half, etc.

params.name: yscale
params.description: The vertical scaling of the image, as a multiplier: 1 = normal scaling, 0.5 is half, etc.

params.name: rot
params.description: The rotation of the image. 0=normal, 90=turned 90 degrees counter-clockwise, etc.
